theorem lg_target (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : (a + b) * (1 / a + 1 / b) ≥ 4 := by
  have h1 : 1 / a + 1 / b = (a + b) / (a * b) := one_div_add_one_div ha hb
  rw [h1]
  have h2 : (a + b)^2 / (a * b) ≥ 4 :=
    have h3 : (a + b)^2 ≥ 4 * a * b :=
      have h4 : (a - b)^2 ≥ 0 := Real.pow_two_nonneg (a - b)
      exact (Real.add_le_add_right h4 (2 * a * b)).trans (Real.mul_le_mul_left (a * b) (Real.le_refl (2 * a * b)))
    exact (Real.mul_le_mul_left (a * b) h3).trans (Real.div_le_div_right (a * b) (Real.pos_of_pos_mul ha hb))
  exact h2
